description: Test file for Busy state management in Mattermost, including unit tests for setting, expiry, and race conditions of Busy objects, as well as a mock cluster for testing cluster interactions.

classes.name: ClusterMock
classes.description: Mock implementation simulating cluster behavior for testing Busy state interactions.

methods.name: TestBusySet
methods.description: Unit test for setting Busy state, expiry, and auto-expiry behavior.

methods.name: TestBusyExpires
methods.description: Unit test for expiry retrieval and reset of Busy state.

methods.name: TestBusyRace
methods.description: Test to trigger race conditions by concurrent Busy state setting.

methods.name: compareBusyState
methods.description: Helper function to compare two Busy objects for consistency in tests.
